records.title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
Vaccines could be a new frontier in KRAS targeting
records.description: A convergence of therapeutic and technological advances reveals KRAS-targeting vaccination as a potential new approach to preventing the recurrence of pancreatic cancer, but many hurdles remain.

records.title: Gut and urogenital microbiomes influence menopausal hormone therapy outcomes
records.description: A 6-month study shows that menopausal hormone therapy induces multi-site microbiome remodeling, including rejuvenation of the vaginal microbial community toward a reproductive-age-like state. In turn, baseline gut and vaginal community types affect the clinical response to therapy. Integrating clinical and gut microbiome features predicts rapid symptom remission, providing a blueprint for precision menopausal care.

records.title: Young people with obesity deserve better care
records.description: The evidence available to support the treatment of obesity in children and adolescents is insufficient and requires rapid improvement.

records.title: Effect of two common GVHD prophylaxis regimens on the gut microbiome in a randomized phase 3 trial
records.description: In a prespecified companion study (BMT CTN 1801) of the randomized phase 3 BMT CTN 1703 trial comparing two common GVHD prophylaxis regimens, microbiome diversity at engraftment did not associate with non-relapse mortality, but secondary analyses found baseline microbiome diversity was associated with clinical outcomes.

records.title: Lessons from recent investigator-initiated trials of gene-editing therapies in China
records.description: Several deaths during trials of experimental cell and gene therapies in China appear to reveal gaps in governance and oversight. A new layer of independent external review is needed for clinical supervision of high-risk therapies.

records.title: Normalized membrane ratio of TROP2 as a predictor of clinical outcomes with datopotamab deruxtecan in non-small-cell lung cancer
records.description: This work developed and validated a computational pathology biomarker—the TROP2 normalized membrane ratio—that quantifies subcellular TROP2 localization and predicts improved progression-free and overall survival with datopotamab deruxtecan in patients with nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer lacking actionable genomic alterations.

records.title: Next-generation KRAS G12C inhibitor improves survival in lung cancer
records.description: Phase 3 trial data show that the next-generation KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib leads to longer progression-free survival than the first-generation inhibitors sotorasib and adagrasib in patients with non–small-cell lung cancer.

records.title: Author Correction: Innate lymphoid cells in the initiation, regulation and resolution of inflammation
A novel candidate biomarker for detecting premalignant and early ovarian cancer
records.description: New data suggest that the long noncoding RNA known as Tu-Stroma represents a promising new circulating biomarker for the detection of ovarian cancer at premalignant and early stages, for which sensitive screening methods currently are lacking.

records.title: Blood-based RNA biomarker for the early detection of ovarian cancer
records.description: Tested in a cohort of 506 individuals, the RNA-based biomarker of microenvironment fitness Tu-stroma shows high performance in discriminating early-stage ovarian cancer from benign lesions, outperforming CA125.

records.title: Deep learning-based gait analysis predicts multisystem health phenotypes
records.description: We developed a gait foundation model from three-dimensional skeletal motion data of 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults, recorded using a depth camera during five motor tasks. Embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 phenotypic targets and provided predictive gains across all 18 body systems in men and 17 out of 18 in women, while also improving prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use.

records.title: Resistance exercise to attenuate lean mass loss during tirzepatide therapy for obesity: a randomized controlled trial
records.description: Participants undergoing resistance exercise while receiving tirzepatide lost less lean mass than participants receiving tirzepatide alone.

records.title: An ulcerative colitis taxonomy defined by individual patient-reported response trajectories
records.description: An analysis of patient-reported trajectories of response to vedolizumab in ulcerative colitis defines disease endotypes and identifies vascular inflammation as a potential resistance mechanism.

records.title: Effects of semaglutide on cardiac structure and function in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity: a pre-specified cardiac magnetic resonance substudy of the CAMEO-SEMA trial
records.description: As presented at the 2026 AHA Scientific Sessions, a cardiac magnetic resonance substudy of the CAMEO-SEMA trial showed that semaglutide significantly improved cardiac structure and function, including left atrial reservoir strain and left ventricular filling dynamics, in individuals with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity.

records.title: Hemodynamic effects of semaglutide in individuals with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity: a placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial
records.description: As presented at the 2026 American Heart Association Scientific Sessions, in a placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial, semaglutide significantly improved pulmonary artery wedge pressure and other hemodynamic parameters during low-intensity exercise in individuals with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity.

records.title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion
records.description: A gait foundation model, developed using three-dimensional skeletal motion data from 3,328 adults, predicts a wide array of clinical characteristics and diagnoses, including cardiometabolic, mental health and frailty phenotypes.

records.title: Digital readiness for cardiovascular care in high-burden US communities with cardiology workforce constraints
records.description: As presented at 2026 AHA Scientific Sessions: Analysis of U.S. Census and other national health data identifies communities with high cardiovascular care needs and assess health system readiness for digital care deployment.

records.title: Opposing microbiome-mediated axes link modifiable lifestyles to health and chronic diseases
records.description: Fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort and microbiome-based prediction scores validated across 13 independent and geographically diverse cohorts revealed two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases.

records.title: Global temperature-related mortality associated with El-Nino Southern Oscillation
records.description: Epidemiological estimates suggest that global heat-related mortality increased by 29% during very strong El Niño years, with the greatest burdens occurring in low- and medium- Human Development Index regions.

records.title: A tumor transcriptomic atlas across eight decades of life reveals distinct features of early-onset colorectal cancer
records.description: The incidence of early-onset colorectal cancer is rising, but whether it is biologically distinct from average-onset disease is unclear. Mapping of the transcriptome of colorectal tumors across the age continuum shows that tumors in younger adults contain more stromal cells and have increased expression of long non-coding RNAs and genes associated with epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition.

records.title: Perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy in resectable non-small cell lung cancer: a phase 2 trial
records.description: In a nonrandomized phase 2 trial, patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer received perioperative ivonescimab as monotherapy or with chemotherapy, leading to encouraging pathological response rates in both cohorts, and sustained circulating tumor DNA negativity throughout neoadjuvant therapy may be predictive of response.

records.title: Author Correction: In vivo base editing gene therapy for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: a phase 1 trial
Publisher Correction: Molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy
Regulatable membrane-bound IL-15 engineered TIL cell therapy for immune checkpoint inhibitor-resistant advanced melanoma: pooled analysis of phase 1 and 1/2 trials
records.description: As presented at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer 2026 Annual Meeting, in a non-prespecified pooled analysis of two trials, amsokigene autoleucel, an autologous tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapy engineered to eliminate the need for IL-2, was successfully manufactured and well tolerated and showed a preliminary clinical efficacy signal in patients with immune checkpoint inhibitor-refractory melanoma.

records.title: Heterogeneity of microbiome responses to menopausal hormone therapy among perimenopausal women
records.description: In this study, the gut, oral, urinary and vaginocervical microbiomes of women receiving menopausal hormone therapy were studied over 6 months, shedding light on how system metagenomics can inform clinical response and care.

records.title: A live biotherapeutic product for adult allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients: a partially randomized, placebo-controlled phase 1b trial
records.description: In a phase 1b study that included an open-label and randomized-controlled cohorts of allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients, treatment with the investigational, cultivated, multi-strain bacterial oral live biotherapeutic product, SER-155, was found to have a similar safety profile to placebo and resulted in fewer bloodstream infections, indicating further clinical investigation of this therapeutic is warranted.

records.title: Global, regional and national burden of cervical cancer in 1990–2023 with forecasts to 2050: a Global Burden of Disease study
records.description: Analyses of the Global Burden of Disease study reported 887,000 new cases and 369,000 deaths from cervical cancer worldwide in 2023, which are forecasted to rise by 2050.

records.title: Neoadjuvant botensilimab with or without balstilimab in pMMR and dMMR colon cancer: the phase 2 UNICORN trial
records.description: In the phase 2 UNICORN trial, a short course of neoadjuvant botensilimab and balstilimab achieved the primary endpoint of pathological major response rate in patients with pMMR or dMMR colon cancer.

records.title: Povorcitinib for nonsegmental vitiligo: two randomized, controlled, phase 3 STOP-V trials
records.description: In the STOP-V1 and STOP-V2 trials, povorcitinib (an oral JAK1 inhibitor) was superior to placebo in improvement in F-VASI75 score in individuals with nonsegmental vitiligo.

records.title: Climate change threatens malaria elimination in the Asia Pacific
records.description: A multidisciplinary group of policymakers and researchers discusses the impacts of climate change on malaria in the Asia Pacific, identifies gaps in national adaptation strategies and outlines five priority actions for the region.

records.title: Applying digital twins to prevent preterm births
records.description: Researchers developed a digital twin framework to safely evaluate the effects of drugs on the immune system and time to labor, which could enable personalized interventions to prevent preterm births.

records.title: A small-molecule TREM2 agonist for Alzheimer’s disease
records.description: Preclinical analysis and a phase 1 trial support VG-3927 as a promising drug candidate for Alzheimer’s disease, demonstrating successful penetration of the central nervous system, target engagement and tolerability.

records.title: 5-year outcomes of chemotherapy de-escalation in HER2-positive early breast cancer and exploratory circulating tumor DNA analyses from the randomized phase 2 PHERGain trial
records.description: A 5-year secondary analysis of the phase 2 PHERGain trial supports the clinical utility of a PET-guided adaptive strategy for treatment de-escalation in HER2-positive early breast cancer and provides circulating tumor DNA insights that could inform further treatment approaches.

records.title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability
records.description: A multimodal vision language foundation model, EVLF-FM, integrates extensive clinical data and advanced training techniques, achieving superior diagnostic accuracy and explainability across diverse imaging modalities, enhancing clinical decision-making through robust reasoning and interpretability.

records.title: Insights into early-onset colorectal cancer from a single-nucleus RNA-seq atlas of colorectal cancer across the age continuum
records.description: A high-resolution snRNA-seq atlas of 189 colorectal tumors from patients aged 20–90+ years uncovers age-associated features of colorectal cancer.

records.title: Editorial Expression of Concern: MicroRNA-133 controls cardiac hypertrophy
Author Correction: Toripalimab or placebo plus chemotherapy as first-line treatment in advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma: a multicenter randomized phase 3 trial
Metabolic heterogeneity of obesity
records.description: This Review examines the cellular, organ-level and whole-body differences between metabolically healthy and metabolically unhealthy obesity, as well as variations in response to weight loss—with the goal of improving strategies for preventing and treating obesity-related metabolic disorders.

records.title: Persistent and compartmentalized T cell immunity in ALS
records.description: In ALS, persistent T cell responses relate to disease outcome differently in blood than in cerebrospinal fluid, with both intrathecal antigen presentation and cytomegalovirus-specific immunity linked to worse clinical outcomes.

records.title: Author Correction: Sex-specific biological aging clocks across organs and omics
Author Correction: Liquid biopsy for early detection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
Neoadjuvant durvalumab plus chemotherapy in resectable or borderline resectable non-small-cell lung cancer: the phase 2 MDT-BRIDGE trial
records.description: As presented at the ESMO Congress 2026: In the global phase 2 MDT-BRIDGE trial, neoadjuvant durvalumab plus chemotherapy in patients with resectable and borderline resectable non-small-cell lung cancer, followed by multidisciplinary reassessment, enabled surgery in most patients, leading to encouraging pathological complete response rates, and no additional safety concerns were reported when patients with unresectable tumors continued with chemoradiotherapy and consolidative durvalumab.

records.title: Neoadjuvant nivolumab with or without visugromab in muscle-invasive bladder cancer: the phase 2a GDFATHER-NEO trial
records.description: As presented at the ESMO Congress 2026: In this exploratory, nonrandomized phase 2a trial, treatment of patients with immune checkpoint inhibitor-naive muscle-invasive bladder cancer with the GDF-15-neutralizing antibody visugromab and nivolumab produced encouraging pathological complete response and radiographic response rates with no new safety signals, supporting further evaluation in larger randomized studies.

records.title: Relatlimab plus nivolumab versus nivolumab for advanced melanoma: 5-year survival and biomarker analyses of the phase 3 RELATIVITY-047 trial
records.description: As presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology Congress 2026: In a 5-year follow-up of survival and correlative data from the pivotal phase 3 RELATIVITY-047 trial comparing relatlimab plus nivolumab versus nivolumab alone in patients with metastatic or unresectable melanoma, statistically significant differences in progression-free survival, overall survival and melanoma-specific survival were seen, with high baseline levels of LAG-3 + CD8 + T cells associated with improved response in the combination arm.

records.title: Putting conversational AI to the test in primary care
records.description: A patient-facing conversational AI showed promising feasibility and safety in a single-center primary care setting, providing a basis for larger-scale evaluation.

records.title: The human microbiome and chronic disease: ten strategic priorities for research and public health
records.description: The human microbiome has emerged as one of the most consequential frontiers in biomedical science. An international group of leading microbiome scientists, convened by the US Department of Health and Human Services, presents a strategic vision for realizing its potential to transform public health.

records.title: Lymph node-targeted, mKRAS-specific amphiphile vaccine in pancreatic cancer: the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
records.description: As presented at the ESMO Congress 2026, in a randomized phase 2 trial evaluating an off-the-shelf lymph node-targeting peptide vaccine in patients with mutated KRAS pancreatic cancer within 6 months of standard curative intent therapy, the primary endpoint of disease-free survival was not met, but prespecified subgroup analyses showed significant disease-free survival benefit in the vaccine arm for patients with circulating tumor DNA-negative disease and in those without prior radiation treatment.

records.title: Bispecific dual T cell agonist invikafusp alfa in solid tumors: the phase 1/2 START-001 trial
records.description: As presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology Congress 2026, in a phase 1/2 trial in participants with solid tumors, invika, a first-in-class bispecific agonistic antibody that selectively targets the prevalent Vβ6/Vβ10 T cell subsets, was well tolerated, enabling the selection of a recommended phase 2 dose for further testing, and showed a preliminary efficacy signal in both immunologically hot and cold tumors.

records.title: Determinants of response to CAR T cell therapy in a multicenter, multi-trial cohort analysis of patients with lymphoma
records.description: A large comprehensive analysis of clinical trial samples from patients with non-Hodgkin lymphoma who were treated with anti-CD19 CAR T therapy shows that a high proportion of naive-like and stem cell memory-like CCR7 + CD45RA + T cells in the pre-infusion CAR T product correlates with improved and prolonged clinical benefit, which was validated in an independent external cohort including different products.

records.title: Milk multi-omics links maternal health to infant growth
records.description: Researchers identify biomarkers that explain how maternal health is linked to mammary gland function, breast milk composition and infant growth, highlighting maternal nutrition as a public health priority.

records.title: Author Correction: β-catenin confers resistance to PI3K and AKT inhibitors and subverts FOXO3a to promote metastasis in colon cancer
Editorial Expression of Concern: Oncogenic transformation of diverse gastrointestinal tissues in primary organoid culture
The need for resilience in global vaccination programs
records.description: New studies of trends in the global burden of measles and pertussis offer a reminder of how much vaccination has achieved and a warning of the need to build more resilient and sustainable vaccination programs.

records.title: Author Correction: Povorcitinib for hidradenitis suppurativa: the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled STOP-HS1 and STOP-HS2 phase 3 trials
Global, regional and national burden of pertussis in 1990–2023: a Global Burden of Disease study
records.description: Updates to the Global Burden of Disease study showed that while global trends in pertussis (whooping cough) declined from 1990 to 2023, the rebound in incidence and mortality since 2020, particularly in high-income regions, reflects stalled vaccination progress worldwide.

records.title: Global and regional burden of measles and vaccine coverage among children under 5 years, 1990−2023: a Global Burden of Disease Study
records.description: Updates to the Global Burden of Disease Study showed that although global measles incidence and mortality had declined in 1990−2019, its resurgence since 2020 reflects stalled vaccination progress worldwide.

records.title: Author Correction: FcRH5×CD3 bispecific antibody cevostamab in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma: a phase 1 trial
Waiting to get sick enough
records.description: The liver can warn us of metabolic dysfunction long before serious consequences emerge. Why aren’t we listening?

records.title: Molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy
records.description: In a multiomic analysis of samples from patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with isatuximab, carfilzomib, lenalidomide and dexamethasone induction therapy followed by consolidation treatment guided by minimal residual disease (MRD) status, baseline genomic, transcriptomic and epigenetic features are associated with MRD status after induction.

records.title: Only time will tell
records.description: Chronotherapy promises to improve medicine by aligning treatment with the body’s internal clock. As this idea moves into clinical trials, a high-profile retraction reveals the ups and downs of circadian medicine.

records.title: A reality check for autoimmune CAR T cells
records.description: The hope with CAR T cell therapies for autoimmune disease is that they can reset the immune system and induce deep remission. But recent trial pauses have renewed concerns about safety, patient selection and acceptable risk.

records.title: Conversational brain AI for adaptive epilepsy care
records.description: A small study shows that patients can help fine-tune their own seizure detectors by chatting with an AI agent. However, the more difficult challenge ahead is to build AI that responds appropriately.

records.title: EGFR-targeted antibody−toxin conjugate in recurrent glioma: a phase 1 trial
records.description: Results of a phase 1 trial of the antibody−toxin conjugate D2C7-ATC targeting EGFR/EGFRvIII in patients with recurrent malignant glioma show encouraging safety and efficacy signals, with translational analyses of patient samples indicating intratumoral and systemic immune activation.

records.title: Real-world, digital-first delivery of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in women
records.description: At 6 months, a cohort of 8,127 women in the UK initiating GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy via a digital platform showed mean weight reduction comparable to that in randomized clinical trials.

records.title: Optogenetic therapy shows early promise for treating retinitis pigmentosa
records.description: In a small study involving patients with blindness due to advanced retinitis pigmentosa, optogenetic therapy appears safe; early efficacy signals are promising and reveal opportunities for technical refinement.

records.title: Hidden race disparities in cancer treatment toxicity
records.description: Large-scale analysis of real-world data reveals racial disparities in the occurrence of immune-related adverse events during cancer immunotherapy — which were not evident in trial data, owing to the enrollment of mostly white patients.

records.title: Editorial Expression of Concern: Thyroid hormone inhibits lung fibrosis in mice by improving epithelial mitochondrial function
Making AI work in healthcare
records.description: Drawing on experiences across diverse settings, this issue of Nature Medicine explores the challenges of and lessons learned from the deployment of artificial intelligence models into healthcare.

records.title: Personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines in ovarian cancer: a phase 1 trial
records.description: A phase 1 trial shows that treatment of patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer with personalized neoantigen vaccines combined with PD-1 blockade was feasible and led to tumor-specific immune responses in many patients and putative mechanisms of resistance related to antigen presentation were identified via cell-free DNA analysis.

records.title: Talazoparib plus enzalutamide in high-volume metastatic hormone-naive prostate cancer: a randomized phase 2 trial
records.description: In the randomized multicenter phase 2 ZZ-FIRST trial, patients with high-volume metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor talazoparib combined with androgen receptor inhibitor enzalutamide had an improved prostate-specific antigen response compared with enzalutamide alone, and spatial transcriptomic analyses of paired biopsies linked AR inhibition-induced suppression of HRR-related programs to proliferation arrest rather than functional HRR deficiency.

records.title: Characterizing the onset and progression of cancer cachexia using routine clinical data
records.description: In 52,236 patients with cancer, cachectic weight loss episodes were linked to lower survival rates, occurred at times of disease progression, and carried a consistent serological signature across routine laboratory markers. Specific tumor genotypes, including TP53 mutations, were also positively associated with cachexia risk. Statistical models were trained to predict a patient’s impending risk of cachexia.

records.title: Autologous and broadly neutralizing antibodies drive ART-free HIV control
records.description: A secondary analysis of trial data shows that both host antibodies and infused antibodies against HIV help to delay viral rebound after interruption of antiretroviral therapy (ART), which could inform approaches to durable, ART-free HIV control.

records.title: Human–artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time
records.description: A small epilepsy monitoring study shows that a moderated, large language model-based chat interface lets patients converse with their electroencephalography monitoring in real time, using a smartphone, and patient feedback cut seizure-detector false alarms by about 80% without clinician input.

records.title: A health-system-scale, episode-resolved multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia
records.description: Using longitudinal data from 52,236 patients with cancer, this study created a multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia, demonstrating that weight loss episodes are linked to systemic serologic signatures and specific tumor genotypes and can be predicted using integrated clinical and molecular data, enabling earlier identification.

records.title: Population-scale reconstruction of menopause dynamics reveals a physiological cliff at the final menstrual period
records.description: By using a novel computational framework, a cross-sectional analysis on laboratory data from two independent cohorts reveals that the final menstrual period marks an abrupt, multisystem physiological shift, with sex hormone changes beginning more than 10 years before menopause onset.

records.title: Addendum: Aberrant epithelial GREM1 expression initiates colonic tumorigenesis from cells outside the stem cell niche
AI-assisted scoping review of code sharing in clinical prediction model research
records.description: An analysis of code availability in the open-access published literature shows that code sharing in clinical prediction models remains limited and reveals significant variability in practices and documentation quality.

records.title: Author Correction: Natural killer T cells and CD8 + T cells are dispensable for T cell–dependent allergic airway inflammation
MAGIC: an international network for evaluating generative artificial intelligence in global health
An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications
records.description: MedGemma, a collection of medical vision-language foundation models based on Gemma 3, demonstrates advanced medical understanding and reasoning across images and text and multiple medical imaging domains, exceeding the performance of similarly sized generative models while maintaining the general capabilities of the Gemma base models.

records.title: Extended follow-up of in vivo BCMA CAR-T therapy in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
records.description: Extended follow-up of four patients with multiple myeloma treated with in vivo BCMA CAR-T cells showed limited duration of response in three patients, while one patient had sustained response to 15 months.

records.title: Global and regional reference curves for pain across the lifespan in 6.1 million individuals in 118 countries
records.description: Global age- and sex-specific reference curves for 11 pain sites, from 6.1 million people in 118 countries, found higher late-life pain in the lowest Human Development Index (HDI) countries and provide a tool for benchmarking pain assessments in other cohorts.

records.title: Oral small-molecule GLP-1RA safiglipron versus dapagliflozin in type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, active-comparator-controlled phase 3 trial
records.description: Once-daily oral safiglipron is non-inferior to dapagliflozin for HbA1c reduction at all tested doses and superior at 90 mg, with greater improvements in glycemic control, similar modest weight loss and an acceptable safety profile in adults with type 2 diabetes.

records.title: The missing links in agentic AI autonomy
records.description: A new study tackles issues around operational and decisional trust of agentic artificial intelligence (AI), using locally deployed, on-premise agents and consistency-based gating to refer uncertain cases — but what happens after referral remains untested.

records.title: Small quantity lipid-based nutritional supplementation and measles vaccination coverage in children aged 6−23 months: a pragmatic cluster-randomized trial
records.description: A pragmatic, superiority, cluster-randomized trial done in Yobe State, northern Nigeria, found that distributing small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements alongside routine immunization services substantially increased measles vaccination uptake in children aged 12−23 months.

records.title: Urine cell-free RNA for bladder cancer detection and treatment response prediction
records.description: Applied to samples from more than 600 patients and controls, urinary cell-free RNA profiling with uRARE-seq demonstrated high sensitivity in detecting bladder cancer, and correlated with treatment response.

records.title: Five-year survival with neoadjuvant therapy in melanoma: updated pooled analysis from the International Neoadjuvant Melanoma Consortium (INMC)
records.description: An updated pooled analysis of 3-year and 5-year survival and other outcome data of 1,038 patients with melanoma treated with neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), BRAF and MEK inhibitors (BRAF/MEKis), or a combination of ICIs and targeted therapies shows that ICI as monotherapy or in ICI combinations are superior to BRAF/MEKis and patients with major pathological responses have better long-term survival.

records.title: Effects of semaglutide on kidney disease in type 2 diabetes: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
records.description: A randomized trial in individuals with type 2 diabetes probed the kidney-protective mechanisms of semaglutide using a range of techniques, including histology, multiparametric MRI and transcriptomics.

records.title: Intravenous hyaluronidase-expressing oncolytic adenovirus with chemotherapy in metastatic pancreatic cancer: a randomized phase 2b trial
records.description: In the randomized phase 2b VIRAGE trial, patients with treatment-naive metastatic pancreatic cancer received the hyaluronidase-expressing oncolytic adenovirus zabilugene almadenorepvec (VCN-01) intravenously with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel (GnP) or GnP alone, showing that VCN-01 plus GnP led to prolonged overall survival.

records.title: A synthetic lethal drug for microsatellite instability cancers
records.description: In a phase 1 trial, inhibition of the Werner syndrome helicase (WRN) enzyme exploits a new synthetic lethal vulnerability in cancers with microsatellite instability, offering a new way to target these tumors beyond immune checkpoint inhibition.

records.title: Oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist safiglipron in early type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
records.description: The OUTSTAND-1 trial showed that once-daily oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist safiglipron reduced HbA1c by up to 1.45% versus placebo over 32 weeks in people with type 2 diabetes without glucose-lowering medication while body weight effects were modest.

records.title: Werner helicase inhibitor for advanced microsatellite instability solid tumors: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In the dose-escalation stage of a phase 1 trial evaluating RO7589831, a first-in-class inhibitor of the synthetic lethal target Werner syndrome helicase, in patients with microsatellite instability and/or DNA mismatch repair-deficient solid tumors, the maximum tolerated dose was not reached and some partial responses were observed.

records.title: Reproducibility in biomedical research
records.description: Reproducibility is a foundational principle of trustworthy science, but reproducible research practices are not consistently implemented. This Review summarizes the current landscape including efforts to harmonize terminology and implementation, persistent barriers and ecosystem responses.

records.title: Prime editing goes large
records.description: A technique known as prime assembly expands the capabilities of prime editing, allowing larger genome rearrangements and potentially wider clinical applications.

records.title: Biography of an inherited lung cancer risk gene
records.description: Using data from over 3 million people, researchers trace the ancestral history of the EGFR T790M germline mutation and its present contribution to lung cancer risk in those who never smoked.

records.title: When detecting Ebola is not enough: closing the response interval in DRC
Polygenic scores in the NHS: the debate is not primarily about the evidence
Does expansion of clinical trial capacity improve healthcare access?
records.description: Clinical trials are essential for patient access to biomedical innovation, and China has seen rapid expansion of trials in the past decade. This increase in capacity has been concentrated in top-tier institutions and needs careful management to improve equitable access.

records.title: The next phase of translational medicine must bridge the gap between innovation to impact
records.description: Monumental changes in the translational medicine ecosystem are revealing new challenges and the need for new tools to address them.

records.title: Redesigning cardiovascular medicine around sex differences
records.description: Connecting evidence across preclinical and clinical domains, this Perspective calls for a greater understanding of sex-biased mechanisms and integration of these insights into diagnostics and therapeutics—with a focus on female-predominant cardiovascular conditions.

records.title: Developing cancer-control policies to address the cancer burden among young adults
Evorpacept plus trastuzumab, ramucirumab and paclitaxel in HER2-positive gastric cancer: a randomized phase 2 trial
records.description: In the phase 2 portion of the randomized phase 2/3 ASPEN-06 trial in patients with HER2-positive advanced gastric cancer, which progressed on anti-HER2 treatment, addition of the next-generation CD47 inhibitor evorpacept to trastuzumab, ramucirumab and paclitaxel (TRP) led to a higher objective response rate compared to TRP alone, and response was associated with CD47 and HER2 expression.

records.title: An antibody–drug conjugate for small-cell lung cancer
records.description: Phase 3 trial data support tambotatug pelitecan as a new second-line treatment for patients with relapsed small-cell lung cancer – a group with few existing treatment options.

records.title: Sex and gender differences belong in treatment guidelines
records.description: Clinical guidelines should state what is already known, where evidence is missing and what future trials must report.

records.title: Embryo editing and embryo selection need joint governance
Practical lessons in the global scaling of clinical AI: from one hospital to over a million patients screened
records.description: Scaling a successful deep learning tool across three highly distinct settings – in India, Thailand and Australia — offers cross-cutting insights that may inform the expansion of healthcare artificial intelligence globally.

records.title: Persistence of mucosal CAR-T cells and inflammatory remodeling in enterocolitis associated with BCMA CAR-T cell therapy
records.description: A multimodal analysis of patients with multiple myeloma who developed enterocolitis following BCMA CAR-T cell treatment shows that CAR-T cell-associated enterocolitis is not defined exclusively by plasma cell and B cell depletion, but is associated with expansion of cytotoxic CAR-T cells and coordinated dysregulation across various intestinal compartments, and also supports JAK inhibitors as a potential treatment option.

records.title: AI-based characterization of Alzheimer’s disease phenotypes from population-scale single-cell data
records.description: Based on single-cell data from a cohort of 584 brain donors including patients with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and controls, a graph neural network is used to investigate differential patterns between disease and control, to identify those related to cognitive resilience and to insurgence of depression in patients with AD.

records.title: Some answers, more questions for multi-cancer early detection tests
records.description: The PATHFINDER 2 and NHS-Galleri studies provide complementary evidence on the clinical performance, safety and implementation of multi-cancer early detection, while underscoring the next challenge: demonstrating population-level benefit.

records.title: Performance and safety of a multi-cancer early detection test: the PATHFINDER 2 study
records.description: The interventional PATHFINDER 2 study provides insights on the safety and performance of a blood-based multi-cancer early detection test in an intended-use population, including more than 35,000 participants aged 50 years or older.

records.title: Large-scale esophageal cancer screening through noncontrast computed tomography and artificial intelligence
records.description: In a large-scale study, a new tool called Esophageal AI-Guided malignant Lesion Evaluation uses artificial intelligence to enhance esophageal cancer detection through noncontrast computed tomography, achieving high sensitivity and specificity across diverse settings.

records.title: Performance of a multi-cancer early detection test in the randomized controlled NHS-Galleri trial
records.description: Secondary endpoint analyses in the NHS-Galleri randomized controlled trial, testing a multi-cancer early detection test added to usual care, provide insights on the performance of the blood-based test in more than 142,000 participants without suspicion of cancer.

records.title: Blood proteomics of menopause map to brain aging and dementia risk
records.description: Leveraging proteomic data from nearly 15,000 women across several cohorts, this study found that menopause is associated with hormone-linked molecular changes that correlate with poorer cognitive outcomes later in life and the molecular signatures identified might inform selection of therapeutic targets to improve brain health.

records.title: Trastuzumab plus nivolumab with gemcitabine and cisplatin as first-line therapy for HER2-positive unresectable biliary tract cancer: a phase 1b/2 trial
records.description: In a phase 1b/2 trial, first-line treatment of participants with biliary tract cancer with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-targeting trastuzumab in combination with nivolumab plus gemcitabine and cisplatin showed encouraging clinical response rates and HER2 expression was associated with clinical benefit.

records.title: A consensus-based guideline for personalized bacteriophage therapy
records.description: This consensus-based guideline provides clear and practice-oriented recommendations for the safe and standardized use of personalized phage therapy in the clinic.

records.title: How genes shape personality and experience
records.description: A genome-wide association study involving over one million people reveals genetic contributions to personality traits, with potential causal effects on physical and mental health and behaviors.

records.title: Editorial Expression of Concern: SWI/SNF-mutant cancers depend on catalytic and non-catalytic activity of EZH2
Levetiracetam therapeutically targets GABAergic synapses in diffuse midline glioma
records.description: Results of this study show in experimental models and data from patient cohorts that the antiseizure medication levetiracetam is associated with longer survival and reduced tumor growth in diffuse midline glioma, but not hemispheric high-grade glioma, by selectively dampening GABAergic synaptic signaling, independently of its canonical SV2A-mediated primary antiseizure mechanism.

records.title: EBV reactivation priming of the peripheral immune system in multiple sclerosis relapse
records.description: Increased expression of EBV reactivation genes in B cells and MS risk genes targeted by the EBV protein EBNA-2 precedes MS attacks, linking EBV reactivation and genetic risk to the development of MS relapses.

records.title: EBV reactivation priming of the peripheral immune system in multiple sclerosis relapse
records.description: Increased expression of EBV reactivation genes in B cells and MS risk genes targeted by the EBV protein EBNA-2 precedes MS attacks, linking EBV reactivation and genetic risk to the development of MS relapses.

records.title: Liquid biopsy for early detection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
records.description: In a prospective study involving 1,785 individuals from four countries, the PANXEON exosome-based biomarker, combined with carbohydrate antigen 19-9 levels, achieves high sensitivity for the detection of early-stage pancreatic cancer.

records.title: Factor IX Padua AAV gene therapy in adolescents with hemophilia B: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In this single-arm phase 1 trial, an AAV gene therapy carrying the Padua variant of factor IX was well tolerated in 11 adolescents with hemophilia B and led to reductions in annualized bleeding rate.

records.title: Sex-specific biological aging clocks across organs and omics
records.description: Sex-specific biological aging clocks across multiple organs and molecular systems show that female and male aging patterns can differ in organ-specific, disease-relevant ways.

records.title: Beyond the breakthrough for RAS-driven cancers
records.description: Two early clinical studies of selective KRAS G12D inhibitors show encouraging activity in advanced cancers with G12D mutations, signaling a transformative change in the treatment landscape for RAS-driven cancers with potential applications across tumor types and stages of disease.

records.title: On-premise medical AI agents for reliable clinical decision-making
records.description: An autonomous clinical AI agent enhances decision-making through on-premise deployment and reliability metrics, achieving high diagnostic accuracy and selective autonomy.

records.title: Broadly neutralizing antibodies in adult males living with HIV undergoing analytical treatment interruption: secondary and exploratory outcomes of the phase II randomized controlled RIO trial
records.description: In the phase 2 RIO trial, there was delayed viral rebound and resistance to broadly neutralizing antibodies 3BNC117-LS and 10-1074-LS in adult males living with HIV undergoing analytical treatment interruption, and initial reservoir sensitivity to autologous antibodies was associated with a longer time to rebound.

records.title: Oral KRAS G12D inhibitor GFH375 for previously treated advanced solid tumors with KRAS G12D mutations: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In a phase 1 trial evaluating GFH375, an oral, dual on–off binding KRAS G12D inhibitor, in patients with KRAS G12D -mutated solid tumors, there was one treatment-related death, while most treatment-related adverse events were low-grade, and encouraging response rates were observed in non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic cancer.

records.title: De novo mutations bridge parental reproductive factors and offspring health
records.description: Whole-genome sequencing of 7,851 parent–offspring families enabled the identification of parent-of-origin and post-zygotic de novo mutations that were associated with distinct procedures of assisted reproductive technology (ART), independently of parental age at conception. Increased paternal mutational burden statistically mediates the effects of advanced parental age and ART on gestational duration and other birth outcomes.

records.title: Rethinking the global health system for a new international order
records.description: In this Comment, we argue for a global health system that recognizes and supports countries as the primary agents of action, oriented around global public goods and collective action, and served by a leaner set of global and regional institutions. We present a potential vision for the functions and distribution of labor in the system to inform ongoing reform discussions and draw critique, dissent and amendment.

records.title: Prospective evidence for conversational medical AI is hard, but non-negotiable
records.description: Trust in clinical artificial intelligence (AI) cannot be benchmarked into existence. It must be earned through rigorous prospective studies in real-world clinical settings, where the hardest lessons often concern the humans and systems around the AI, not the technology itself.

records.title: A multimodal murmuration for immunotherapy
records.description: A study shows that integrating numerous multimodal, patient-level biomarkers enhances the prediction of cancer immunotherapy response, but generalizability is still a challenge.

records.title: Clinical usability of an explainable AI decision support tool and evaluation of multimodal models in NSCLC
records.description: In a large international real-world study of non-small cell lung cancer, a multimodal explainable AI model outperformed established biomarkers for immunotherapy outcome prediction and improved physician decision-making.

records.title: A global digital navigator of human health for precision medicine
records.description: The International Consortium of Digital Twins in Healthcare and Medicine was established to advance medical digital twin technology as a new infrastructure for precision health.

records.title: Teclistamab versus lenalidomide-dexamethasone in high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma: a randomized phase 2 trial
records.description: In the randomized phase 2 ImmunoPRISM trial, patients with high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma (MM) showed higher rates of complete clinical responses in response to treatment with teclistamab compared with lenalidomide–dexamethasone, although longer follow-up is required to determine durable prevention of progression to MM.

records.title: Joint impact of pathological burden and cognitive resilience on Alzheimer’s disease risk
records.description: A 15-year cohort study shows that Alzheimer’s dementia risk is jointly shaped by Alzheimer’s pathology and cognitive resilience, with high resilience linked to lower risk, even under greater pathology.

records.title: A clinically-oriented foundation model for intraoperative pathology
records.description: CRISP, a vision-based pathology foundation model developed exclusively from frozen section slides, supports treatment decision-making throughout the surgical workflow with superior performance to current foundation models and extensive validation, including in a prospective cohort.

records.title: Our Future Health and the next generation of population medicine
records.description: An early assessment of the UK’s Our Future Health project shows how national-scale cohorts may reshape population medicine by accelerating discovery and clinical recruitment, provided that selection and phenotyping biases are carefully measured and managed.

records.title: Author Correction: Colonoscopy and fecal immunochemical testing versus usual care in diagnostic colorectal cancer screening: the SCREESCO randomized controlled trial
Initial lessons from real-world implementation of an AI-agent eye clinic in China
records.description: The transition from AI-assisted tools to more integrated, AI-native models of care requires workflow integration, clinician engagement and measurable clinical value.

records.title: The Value Cube: translating clinical benefit into realizable value in global oncology
Phenomic profiles and disease patterns of 1.9 million participants from Our Future Health
records.description: An in-depth phenomic analysis of health and disease patterns from 1.9 million participants of the Our Future Health cohort reports the prevalence of health conditions and medication-use patterns compared with national UK estimates and the UK Biobank.

records.title: COVID-19 vaccination around immune checkpoint inhibitor start and survival in a nationwide cohort of patients with cancer
records.description: This large, population-based analysis shows that both pre- and post-ICI COVID-19 mRNA vaccinations were associated with modest early improvements in overall survival, primarily within the first few months, although similar patterns with other vaccines suggest non-specific effects rather than a vaccine-specific benefit.

records.title: A bispecific CD3×CD19 antibody for systemic lupus erythematosus: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In a phase 1 trial evaluating intravenous delivery of a next-generation CD3×CD19 bispecific T cell engager in patients with active systemic lupus erythematosus, treatment was well tolerated, and there were improvements in disease activity scores for most patients.

records.title: Computable longitudinal patient journeys from structured and unstructured EHR data
records.description: A suite of large pretrained language models accurately extracts computable clinical data from unstructured electronic health records and integrates the findings into knowledge graphs that can facilitate understanding patient trajectories and treatment responses in the real world.

records.title: Author Correction: Ablation of TRIP-Br2 , a regulator of fat lipolysis, thermogenesis and oxidative metabolism, prevents diet-induced obesity and insulin resistance
Consensus framework for the validation of generative AI: call for collaborators on the Validation Accords
To bridge the evidence gap in women’s health, look at the real world
records.description: As the availability of clinical trial data continues to lag behind, other forms of evidence generation leveraging real-world data and citizen science need to be considered to improve women’s health.

records.title: Inhaled siRNA therapy targeting RAGE for pulmonary inflammation: a first-in-human randomized trial
records.description: Following preclinical development, a randomized first-in-human trial showed that treatment with an inhaled, lung-epithelium-targeted siRNA directed against the receptor for advanced glycation end-products (RAGE) was safe and well tolerated and reduced RAGE levels in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid.

records.title: Myeloperoxidase inhibition with mitiperstat in heart failure with preserved or mildly reduced ejection fraction: a randomized phase 2b trial
records.description: In a phase 2 randomized clinical trial, treatment with the myeloperoxidase (MPO) inhibitor mitiperstat, intended to target the neutrophil–MPO inflammatory pathway, did not improve symptoms or exercise function in individuals with heart failure with preserved or mildly reduced ejection fraction.

records.title: A binding ban, and its limits: Japan legislates on heritable human genome editing
From algorithms to patient outcomes — lessons from one of the first randomized trials of AI in medicine
records.description: The first generation of medical artificial intelligence (AI) was judged on whether algorithms could match clinicians. The next generation should be judged on whether carefully designed human–AI systems can improve patient outcomes.

records.title: Strengthening clinical trial ethics and regulatory oversight in Africa: lessons from the TRACE initiative
Prediction of maternal and infant outcomes from longitudinal electronic health records with a mother–child AI agent
records.description: A large-language-model-based clinical assistant that orchestrates several tools to integrate sequential electronic health record data can forecast maternal and infant conditions, opening a window of opportunity to enhance risk-stratified care for mothers and infants.

records.title: Reply to: Limited benchmarks constrain the conclusions of a general-purpose versus clinical AI comparison
Gene alteration in human brain suggests genetic and epigenetic roots of major depression
records.description: A large, multimodal molecular characterization of the adult human hippocampus provides evidence for sustained neurogenesis and identifies a stalled neurogenic process in major depressive disorder (MDD). Cell- and circuit-specific genetic, epigenetic, stress, immune, metabolic and synaptic mechanisms are identified that underlie impaired hippocampal plasticity, providing a framework for disease subtyping and therapeutic development.

records.title: Limited benchmarks constrain the conclusions of a general-purpose versus clinical AI comparison
Induced proximity comes of age
records.description: The first approved PROTAC for breast cancer validated the idea that medicines can work by bringing proteins together rather than by simply blocking them. Now, a new generation of proximity-based therapies is pushing that principle further.

records.title: Isthmin 2 could determine the early origins of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction
records.description: Preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction (FGR) are major causes of fetal morbidity and mortality globally. Both conditions are associated with impaired invasion of the uterus by trophoblasts. We found that lower maternal serum levels of isthmin 2 (ISM2) in early pregnancy are predictive of preeclampsia and FGR and that ISM2 is essential for trophoblast invasion.

records.title: Author Correction: Activating mutations in CSF1R and additional receptor tyrosine kinases in histiocytic neoplasms
Altered oligodendrocyte function promotes cognitive decline in aging
records.description: Leveraging a human brain tissue bank with cognitive data across the lifespan, we identify a role for oligodendrocytes — myelin-producing cells in the brain — in age-related cognitive decline. With worsening cognitive decline, oligodendrocytes become dysfunctional and produce myelin of poor integrity, and experimental modeling of this myelin pathology impairs cognitive performance in aging.

records.title: Isthmin-2 is a first-trimester predictor of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction
records.description: Through exploration of serum proteomics from pregnancy cohorts, Miao et al. have shown that ISM2 is involved in extravillous trophoblast invasion and that lower levels in early pregnancy may indicate increased risk of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction.

records.title: Antifungal therapy improves microbiome dynamics in inflammatory bowel disease
records.description: In an prospective observational study of patients with inflammatory bowel disease with oral thrush, the treatment of fluconazole (orogastrointestinal therapy), but not nystatin (oral therapy), led to intestinal mycobiome and microbiome alterations and improved disease activity at 8 weeks of follow-up.

records.title: Atezolizumab in early triple-negative breast cancer: the randomized phase 3 NSABP B-59/GeparDouze trial
records.description: The phase 3 NSABP B-59/GeparDouze trial, in which patients with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer received neoadjuvant chemotherapy with or without atezolizumab, did not meet its primary endpoint of event-free survival, and comprehensive translational analyses show tumor microenvironment-dependent determinants of response, with basal-like immune-activated tumors potentially responding to atezolizumab and chemotherapy.

records.title: Short-term effects of combinations of heart failure therapies on blood pressure, kidney function and serum potassium
records.description: A cross-trial analysis using data from 38,753 participants across nine trials estimates effects of comprehensive medical therapy for heart failure on blood pressure, kidney function and potassium levels, potentially guiding safer therapy initiation.

records.title: Obesity medicines as disruptive innovation
records.description: Health systems must adapt to a new era of obesity treatment.

records.title: Eplontersen with and without background transthyretin stabilizers in transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy: secondary analysis of a phase 3, randomized controlled trial
records.description: As presented at the 2026 ESC Congress, in a secondary analysis of the CARDIO-TTRansform trial testing the transthyretin-targeting antisense oligonucleotide eplontersen in patients with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy, a beneficial effect was observed in patients who were not on transthyretin stabilizers at baseline, but not in those who were on stabilizers.

records.title: Dual antithrombotic therapy using potent antiplatelet inhibitors in atrial fibrillation and acute coronary syndrome: a randomized controlled trial
records.description: As presented at the 2026 European Society of Cardiology Congress, use of direct oral anticoagulants together with potent P2Y12 inhibitors in patients with atrial fibrillation and acute coronary syndrome was associated with higher bleeding rates without evidence of reduced ischemic events, as compared to direct oral anticoagulants together with clopidogrel and aspirin.

records.title: What 5-year-old brain organoids can teach us
records.description: Human brain organoids cultured for 5 years exhibit epigenetic aging dynamics that mirror those seen in vivo, which makes them a powerful tool for studying postnatal brain development.

records.title: London’s clean air zone benefits child health
records.description: Children’s lung function growth has accelerated since the introduction of London’s ultra-low-emission zone, which addresses a critical evidence gap and supports wider adoption of this approach.

records.title: Scaling rapid whole-genome sequencing for critical pediatric care in the Middle East
records.description: We describe the large-scale implementation of Little Falcon, a rapid whole-genome sequencing (rWGS) program that enables improved diagnosis and management of critically ill pediatric patients in Dubai. Our study demonstrates the clinical utility of rWGS in populations of Middle Eastern and Asian ancestries.

records.title: Induced pluripotent stem cells from discovery to translation
records.description: Following two decades of development, iPSC-derived interventions are shifting from bespoke experimental models toward standardized, engineered biological medicines.

records.title: CD19 CAR T cell therapy for treatment-refractory seropositive rheumatoid arthritis: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In the phase 1 part of the ongoing phase 1/2 COMPARE trial, CD19 CAR T cell treatment of patients with severe, treatment-refractory rheumatoid arthritis was well tolerated with clinical improvement seen in all patients.

records.title: Tracing the origins of babies’ microbiomes
records.description: A large study of mother–infant pairs shows that the maternal gut microbiome is a major reservoir for infant gut strains, which impacts early health outcomes such as eczema.

records.title: Overcrowded Ebola treatment centers are fueling transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Publisher Correction: Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells in B cell lymphomas
A multi-faceted hospital-based intervention for intrapartum care in sub-Saharan Africa: a stepped-wedge cluster-randomized trial
records.description: A stepped-wedge cluster-randomized trial showed that implementation of a multi-faceted ALERT intervention that promoted essential practices of intrapartum childbirth reduced the odds of early perinatal mortality but not stillbirth across 16 hospitals in Benin, Malawi, Tanzania and Uganda.

records.title: Recombinant shingles vaccination and the risk of cardiovascular events
records.description: A natural experiment comparing recipients of the live attenuated versus recombinant herpes zoster vaccines found that the recombinant vaccine was associated with a lower incidence of cardiovascular events across 7 years of follow-up.

records.title: Beyond Ebola: armed conflict and humanitarian funding cuts threaten control of malaria, TB and HIV in eastern DRC
Author Correction: Survodutide in adults with obesity and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
A case of Bundibugyo virus disease treated with monoclonal antibodies and remdesivir
records.description: In a case report of an individual with Bundibugyo virus infection, treatment with emergency use of the monoclonal antibody cocktail MBP134 with remdesivir and supportive care treatment resulted in recovery and discharge 22 days after symptom onset, supporting further evaluation of MBP134.

records.title: Citywide implementation of a rapid whole-genome sequencing program for critically ill pediatric patients
records.description: Little Falcon, a citywide rapid whole-genome sequencing program implemented within centralized neonatal and pediatric intensive care units within the Dubai healthcare system, led to clinically meaningful shifts in care trajectory in 53% of patients.

records.title: Post-exposure prophylaxis with a monoclonal antibody cocktail after Bundibugyo ebolavirus exposure in adults and children
records.description: In a case series of an adult and four children with high- to intermediate-risk exposure to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, emergency use post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) monoclonal antibody cocktail (MBP134) treatment was well tolerated with no evidence of Bundibugyo virus disease, supporting future evaluation of MBP134 as PEP for outbreaks.

records.title: The trials of translating psilocybin treatment from research to practice
records.description: A feasibility trial delivering psilocybin-assisted therapy for treatment-resistant depression within the UK health service reports encouraging adherence and safety — it opens future questions about who is reached, where treatment happens and what standards will be needed to sustain it.

records.title: Putting epigenetic aging clocks on trial
records.description: A new study offers the first systematic test of whether DNA methylation clocks behave the way a surrogate endpoint for aging should, responding to genuine clinical benefit and remaining stable when there is none.

records.title: Can traditional medicines go mainstream?
records.description: Traditional medicine is already used by billions worldwide. Researchers, regulators and the World Health Organization (WHO) are now working to generate acceptable evidence, win regulatory acceptance, and integrate traditional medicines into modern clinical care.

records.title: Dysregulated adult hippocampal neurogenesis in major depressive disorder
records.description: The largest multiomic atlas of the adult human hippocampus identifies disrupted neurogenesis, gene regulation and neural circuits in major depressive disorder, revealing molecular pathways and potential therapeutic targets related to stress, cellular aging and neuroplasticity.

records.title: Responsiveness of epigenetic aging biomarkers to longevity interventions in humans
records.description: The responsiveness of 16 different epigenetic aging clocks to a broad array of pharmacological and lifestyle interventions in humans was assessed across 51 different longitudinal studies, providing insights into the potential of aging clocks to serve as reliable aging biomarkers.

records.title: Intercepting pancreatic cancer with a vaccine
records.description: An ‘off-the-shelf’ vaccine that targets mutant KRAS can safely and durably activate T cell responses in healthy people at high risk of developing pancreatic cancer, according to a phase 1 study.

records.title: County surveillance failed to detect that measles transmission reached epidemic threshold in schools
records.description: A nationwide analysis of measles vaccination records from more than 50,000 US schools shows that measles transmission risk crossed the threshold that can lead to epidemics at the school level in the 2–3 years before the 2025–2026 outbreaks, whereas county-level estimates always remained below that threshold.

records.title: Waking from the nightmare of PTSD
records.description: Dronabinol, the pharmaceutical form of Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol, shows promise in the treatment of nightmares related to post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), but additional studies are needed to confirm safety and efficacy.

records.title: The px1 locus is linked to declining susceptibility to malaria drugs in Uganda
records.description: The emergence and spread of drug resistance threatens progress toward malaria control and elimination. We identified a rapidly spreading haplotype on chromosome 7 of Plasmodium falciparum that contains mutations and deletions in the px1 gene. This genomic locus is strongly associated with reduced susceptibility of P. falciparum to the primary first-line antimalarial drugs lumefantrine and dihydroartemisinin.

records.title: Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department
records.description: A pilot implementation study of a large language model clinical decision support system in a tertiary emergency department showed safe integration but steadily declining clinical adoption over 4 weeks.

records.title: Intramyocardial injection of allogeneic human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes in advanced ischemic heart failure: an early-stage randomized trial
records.description: In an early-stage randomized trial, the safety and efficacy of intramyocardial injection of hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes in patients with advanced heart failure were evaluated.

records.title: Traumatic brain injury outcomes across human development index strata in 29 countries
records.description: The Global Neurosurgical Study-1 (GNS-I), conducted across 100 hospitals in 29 countries, found substantial variation in the causes of traumatic brain injury and in associated mortality outcomes across Human Development Index tiers.

records.title: Large-scale AI-guided liver malignancy diagnosis: multicenter study and a single-arm trial
records.description: Liver DiagnOsis Network (LiON), a contrast-enhanced-computed tomography-based AI system that supports flexible multiphase processing, clinical data integration and workflow-compatible liver malignancy diagnosis, may help reduce missed or delayed diagnoses and guide clinical interventions.

records.title: Food is medicine: an opportunity to transform nutrition care in oncology
County, district and community-level measles transmission in the United States in 2013−2025
records.description: Multiscale modeling shows that measles transmission at the school level in the United States crossed the epidemic threshold after 2022−2023, a shift not detectable by county-level or district-level surveillance.

records.title: Emergence and spread of Plasmodium falciparum PX1 polymorphisms associated with decreased susceptibility to antimalarials in Uganda
records.description: Whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates of Plasmodium falciparum in Uganda reveals rapid selection of a PX1-associated haplotype linked to reduced susceptibility to commonly used antimalarials.

records.title: Reconstructing disease burden data in armed conflict
An AI-Health infrastructure for the Nordic region: technical foundations, data assets, and a roadmap for deployment
records.description: In this Comment, we outline the Nordic AI-Health Initiative platform, built on unique large-scale longitudinal and multimodal health data sets from across the region. The platform is designed to enable secure, regulation-compliant access and to deliver generalizable models for responsible AI-driven discovery in medicine.

records.title: Histological aging signatures for monitoring tissue-specific aging and disease
records.description: Whole-slide histopathological images from 40 tissue types reveal morphological changes associated with aging, which, when paired with transcriptomic data from blood, are used to develop aging clocks that reflect tissue structural integrity and organ-level physiological fitness in health and disease.

records.title: Regulatory fragmentation as the hidden barrier to regional vaccine sovereignty
AI decision support is scaling-up fast — can the evidence keep up?
records.description: A new generation of clinical decision support tools is moving into practice, reshaping how evidence is generated, evaluated and used.

records.title: How to build an AI-driven digital organism
records.description: Manipulating biology in the physical world is complex; the authors envision an AI-driven digital organism—a system of integrated multiscale foundation models—detailing how to construct and use such a model to advance biological and medical research.

records.title: Editorial Expression of Concern: Evidence from a genetic fate-mapping study that stem cells refresh adult mammalian cardiomyocytes after injury
Frugal AI is the missing piece in cervical cancer screening
records.description: Automated visual evaluation (AVE) could be transformative for cervical cancer screening in low-resource settings. However, AVE research has yet to yield robust clinical tools. Frugal approaches are needed that emphasize efficient, multimodal models, explainable outputs, local calibration and evaluation in real-world screening workflows.

records.title: Sleep as therapy
records.description: Once seen as a symptom, disrupted sleep is emerging as a modifiable driver of chronic illness. Drugmakers are targeting sleep pathways to reshape chronic disease biology, from pain to depression.

records.title: First-line PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody plus chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer: a phase 2 trial
records.description: In a multicenter, phase 2 trial, patients with treatment-naive locally advanced unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer were treated with the PD-1/vascular endothelial growth factor bispecific antibody ivonescimab plus chemotherapy, resulting in encouraging preliminary objective response rates, which support further testing in a large, randomized, phase 3 trial.

records.title: From RAS inhibitor resistance to rational combination strategies
records.description: As new drugs that target mutant RAS redefine the therapeutic landscape in the treatment of pancreatic cancer, understanding and intercepting resistance is critical; a new study reveals mechanisms of acquired genetic resistance to daraxonrasib, highlighting putative combination approaches.

records.title: Anti-aging interventions need less hype and more clinical evidence
records.description: The aging field needs to develop reliable biomarkers of aging and a solid evidence base for the safety and efficacy of anti-aging treatments.

records.title: Reinventing health communication for the digital era
records.description: The commissioners behind the Nature Medicine Quality Health Information for All Commission explain why improving access to accurate, timely and evidence-based information is now essential to global health.

records.title: Acquired resistance to the RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor daraxonrasib guides rational combination therapy strategies in pancreatic cancer
records.description: Circulating tumor DNA analyses in 44 patients with pancreatic cancer receiving the RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor daraxonrasib as part of a phase 1/2 trial, and preclinical translational modeling approaches, identify mechanisms of acquired resistance to monotherapy and inform potential combination strategies to overcome resistance.

records.title: Editorial Expression of Concern: CDK4 coexpression with Ras generates malignant human epidermal tumorigenesis
Global access to different classes of diabetes medicines: a framework for targeted policy actions
Lessons from deploying the ChatEHR system at Stanford Medicine
records.description: In piloting and deploying a large language model within a large medical center, we learned that benchmark-based evaluations are insufficient for monitoring and evaluating interactions driven by clinicians, and that this requires new methods for monitoring performance.

records.title: Obinutuzumab β for aquaporin-4-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder: a phase 3 randomized controlled trial
records.description: In a phase 3 trial, obinutuzumab β significantly reduced relapse risk by 93.1% versus placebo in patients with AQP4-IgG + NMOSD, improved clinical and MRI outcomes, showed manageable safety and demonstrated sustained efficacy with no relapses during extended follow-up.

records.title: Emergence of a Bundibugyo virus variant in the 2026 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
records.description: A phylogenetic analysis of 22 genomes from the recent Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda suggests the outbreak was caused by a new zoonotic spillover event.

records.title: Type 2 diabetes prevention across the life course
records.description: Rather than intervening when dysglycemia is established, prevention efforts should focus on prediabetes remission and restoration of normoglycemia. Here the authors call for a new agenda informed by mechanistic heterogeneity, a life-course risk architecture and scalable precision tools.

records.title: Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells in B cell lymphomas
records.description: Analysis of longitudinal blood samples shows that CD19 CAR T cells can be detected at least 10 years after treatment in patients with lymphoma, with deeper profiling from a single patient showing that these CAR T cells have a dominant double-negative activated effector-memory-like phenotype.

records.title: Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells in B cell lymphomas
records.description: Analysis of longitudinal blood samples shows that CD19 CAR T cells can be detected at least 10 years after treatment in patients with lymphoma, with deeper profiling from a single patient showing that these CAR T cells have a dominant double-negative activated effector-memory-like phenotype.

records.title: Large-scale whole-genome sequencing reveals the landscape and health implications of de novo mutations
records.description: This whole-genome sequencing study based on 7,851 parent−offspring families shows that parental age and assisted reproductive technologies influence the number and types of de novo mutations, highlighting potential health impacts and the need to optimize reproductive practices.

records.title: A clinically validated framework for auditing AI chatbot behavior in mental health interactions
records.description: Across 810 conversations, an evaluation framework finds that AI chatbots often amplify simulated users’ psychological vulnerabilities, revealing persistent safety risks in mental health contexts.

records.title: Intracranial delivery of B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells for recurrent glioblastoma: a phase 1 trial
records.description: In this phase 1 dose-escalation trial, intracranial delivery of B7-H3-targeting chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy in patients with glioblastoma showed no dose-limiting toxicity signals and encouraging signals of clinical benefit.

records.title: Psilocybin-assisted therapy for treatment-resistant major depressive disorder in a public healthcare setting: a randomized controlled trial
records.description: In a publicly funded trial undertaken in the NHS in England, 60 adults with treatment-resistant major depression received psilocybin or placebo alongside standardized psychological support, with psilocybin showing significant improvements in depression symptoms, good tolerability and support for further research in public healthcare settings.

records.title: Dronabinol for nightmares in post-traumatic stress disorder: a randomized controlled trial
records.description: A randomized controlled trial found that dronabinol significantly reduced both the frequency and intensity of nightmares in patients with PTSD over 10 weeks, compared with placebo.

records.title: Divergent impacts of explainable AI for dermatological diagnosis on clinicians versus lay people
records.description: Explainable AI, implemented for large language models that assist with dermatological diagnoses, has differing effects depending on whether the assistance is provided to primary care physicians or to lay users.

records.title: Non-invasive tests for the evaluation of liver fibrosis in MASLD
records.description: In the LITMUS imaging study, we assessed non-invasive alternatives to liver biopsy histopathology in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Elastography and elastography-based composite scores had sufficient diagnostic accuracy to replace liver biopsy histopathology in evaluating advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis, but no markers were accurate enough for diagnosing metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH).

records.title: The next generation of antibody–drug conjugates
records.description: The authors outline strategies to maximize the impact of ADCs by integrating multiple chemistry advances into drug constructs, and developing infrastructures and tools to accelerate and de-risk the preclinical and early clinical development of these agents.

records.title: Humanoid robots perform successful surgery in animals
records.description: A humanoid robot, controlled remotely by a human surgeon, performed laparoscopic gallbladder removal in pigs — which revealed key insights for future optimization and clinical translation.

records.title: ‘Heading’ the ball linked to spikes in neural damage biomarkers
records.description: Amateur-level soccer players who ‘headed’ the ball during a single match showed immediate dose–response elevations in p-Tau217 and S100B in the blood.

records.title: Learning from routine health system data builds better neuroimaging AI models
records.description: We trained a three-dimensional visual foundation model directly on 5.24 million routine clinical computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) image series so that it learned a shared representation of neuroanatomy and disease. The model demonstrated state-of-the-art diagnosis, in contrast to foundation models that are trained on public Internet and medical data, and enabled preliminary report generation and triage in real health systems.
